note: Synthetic. Every claim here is invented. Queries are split into paraphrase (few shared words, meaning search should help) and exact (a literal term, keyword search should help).

claims.text: Burst pipe flooded the kitchen and ruined the lower cabinets. Plumber invoice attached.
Washing machine hose failed and soaked the laundry room floor while we were out.
Roof leaked during the storm and stained the bedroom ceiling.
Basement took on water after the sump pump stopped working overnight.
Rear ended at a red light. Bumper and trunk need repair, other driver admitted fault.
Side swipe in the parking lot left a long dent along the driver door.
Struck a deer on the highway at dusk. Front end and radiator damaged.
Laptop and camera stolen from a parked car. Police report filed the same day.
Bicycle taken from the garage overnight. The lock had been cut.
Burglary while the family was on vacation. Jewelry and a television missing.
Grease fire on the stove spread to the cabinets. Smoke damage throughout the house.
Electrical short started a fire in the garage. Fire department responded.
Slipped on icy steps and fractured a wrist. Physical therapy twice a week.
Strained back lifting boxes at work. Chiropractor visits and light duty.
Whiplash after a car accident. Neck pain treated with massage and exercises.
Application said the home was owner occupied but the inspection found it was rented out.
Earlier rust and body damage were not disclosed on the application. Photos show it predates the policy.
Claim was reported four months after the storm. No photos were taken at the time.
Receipts for the stolen items were requested three times and never provided.
High winds blew down the fence and a tree fell on the garden shed.
Dishwasher overflowed and warped the hardwood floor in the dining area.
Hail dented the hood and roof of the parked sedan.
Wallet and phone snatched from a purse at the train station.
Candle left burning ignited curtains in the living room. Two rooms scorched.
Knee surgery after a skiing fall. Orthopedic follow up and crutches for six weeks.
Claimant gave conflicting dates of loss in two separate statements.
Repair estimate from the body shop was double the usual cost for similar damage.
Frozen pipe split in the attic and dripped through the hallway ceiling.
Rented moving truck backed into a gate and bent the frame.
Tenant moved out leaving mold behind the bathroom wall. Remediation quote attached.
